"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"This is online E log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs .This e-log book also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on comment box is welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;I have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECHIEF\u0026nbsp; COMPOAINTS:\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/o facial puffiness since 5 months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/o bilateral swelling of lower limbs since 5months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHOPI :\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Epatient was apparently asymptomatic 5months ago then developed facial puffiness which was insidious,on and off only in morning, gradually decreased by night followed by pedal edema in both legs extends upto mid-thigh, pitting type, gradually progressive.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o\u0026nbsp; shortness of breath class 2NYHA abdominal distension swelling of both hands.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o\u0026nbsp; decreased urine output, fever\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o chest pain, palpitations\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o cough,cold, constipation\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o rash , itching\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPAST HISTORY\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EK\/C\/O nephrotic syndrome secondary to membranous nephropathy ( serological diagnosis) since 1 year 3 cycles of modified ponticelli regimen Was given and on regular medication.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EK\/C\/O HTN since 2 years was on TAB clonidine 0.1mg PO\/OD ,TAB CINOD 10mg PO\/BD ,TAB.METXL 25 mg PO\/BD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EK\/C\/O DM since 2 years was on TAB.LINAGLIPTIN 5mg PO\/OD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EN\/K\/C\/O epilepsy , thyroid disorders,CVACAD,ASTHMA,TB\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is conscious coherent cooperative\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo pallor, icterus,cyanosis, clubbing, pedal edema present on both lower limbs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cb\u003EVITALS\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBP 130\/80mmhg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPR 88 bpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERR 18cpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESPO2 98%\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETemp 96F\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECVS: S1S2 heard no murmurs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECNS:BAE + ,NO added sounds\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERS: 18cpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EP\/A soft scaphoid and no distension nephrologist opinion I\/v\/o nephrotic syndrome\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAdv- T .WYSOLONE 50MG PO\/OD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETAB TELMA -40MG PO\/OD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETAB . MYCOPHENOLATE 500MG PO\/OD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOPHTHALMOLOGY REFERRAL I\/v\/o diabetic retinopathy changes: normal fundus study,no retinopathy changes\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECOURSE IN THE HOSPITAL\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;65yr old male came with complaints of generalised swellings of lower limbs,upper limbs, abdominal distension.on further history taking pt was diagnosed to have nephrotic syndrome secondary to membranous nephropathy ( serological diagnosis,serum PLA2R+) modified ponticelli regimen was started in July 2023 and 3 cycles were given,but patient discontinued follow up since march and on irregular medication.on further investigations pt was found to have proteinuria nephrology opinion was taken and advised TAB WYSOLONE 5 mg po\/of,TAB .MET XL 50mg po\/od,TAB TELMA -40mg po\/od ,TAB. MYCOPHENOLATE 500mg po\/od . Biopsy couldn't performed due to presence of renal cysts.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient vitals are stable at the Time of\u0026nbsp;
